_about: James Adam (1860-1907), Cambridge Platonist, editor of the Republic. Raw IA OCR: The Religious Teachers of Greece, Gifford lectures delivered in Aberdeen in 1904-06, edited with a memoir by his wife Adela Marion Adam (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark; printed for the University of Aberdeen, 1908). His Greek editions are texts with commentary and are not taken here. US public domain. No uids minted.
